text:
Sam_AE: KiteCorp is asking for a Private POC next week. They want BYOK (AWS KMS + HSM) and need cert/key handoff details. Timeline: customer expects POC environment by Tues. Who owns CSR signing, key import, attestation steps? Any blockers from security or infra?
Jess_SE: TL;DR: we don't accept private keys over Slack/email. Two supported flows: (1) customer-managed KMS called from our Private deployment via VPC endpoints, or (2) key import/attestation for HSM-backed keys + provide public JWK. For certs we accept CA-signed certs; we can provide CSR template. I'll outline steps below.
Leo_Sec: Security notes: require least-privilege KMS policy, rotate keys after POC, require HSM attestation cert for any HSM-backed key. No private key transfer via unencrypted channels. Audit logging must be enabled and exported (we'll ask for CloudTrail/Syslog).
Maya_Onboard: I'll run the handoff. Typical minimal checklist: 1) Provide CSR PEM for server cert (SANs: api.kitecorp.internal + ip if needed). 2) Provide KMS ARN/alias and IAM principal we should use. 3) Provide HSM attestation token/cert if using HSM. 4) Network: VPC peering details and allowed egress. 5) Contact for netops. I'll generate ephemeral API key for initial smoke tests (72h TTL).
Art_Infra: For Private deployments: if they want mTLS we need server cert + client CA bundle. If they want HSM-backed TLS private keys on their side we integrate via PKCS#11 or call their KMS via signed requests. We'll need PKCS#11 module info or KMS endpoint + VPC endpoint config. Also confirm required formats: cert PEM, PKCS12 only if they request keystore.
kitecorp_ops: Quick Qs from our side: we run Vault + AWS KMS. Can we import key material into AWS KMS for the POC? Also can we provide an HSM attestation statement? We use Thales and YubiHSM.
Jess_SE: AWS KMS supports ImportKeyMaterial for symmetric keys. We recommend asymmetric keys for signing operations where possible. For TLS keys you can provide CA-signed certs; we don't require import for TLS if customer manages the private key entirely. For HSM attestation please provide vendor attestation cert + serial, and an audit/trust chain.
Sam_AE: Also need to confirm pricing: is BYOK/HSM going to change POC pricing? Sales needs to set expectations.
Maya_Onboard: POC is covered under normal eval—no extra charge for onboarding itself. If we need to deploy custom HSM connectors or dedicate infra beyond standard Private tier, there may be an infra fee. I'll confirm and escalate to finance if needed.
Leo_Sec: Implementation options for secret handling: (A) We never hold private keys: customer stores keys in their KMS and we call it via a VPC private endpoint (recommended). (B) Customer exports public key material (e.g., JWK) and we configure it on our side. (C) Key import—customer imports key material into a Redwood-managed KMS (less preferred). Document this choice in the handoff.
Jess_SE: CSR example for customer to run:
```
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -keyout kite_poc.key -out kite_poc.csr -subj '/CN=api.kitecorp.internal' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:api.kitecorp.internal'
```
Do not upload kite_poc.key anywhere. Only upload kite_poc.csr / public cert.
Art_Infra: We'll provide a signed S3 presigned URL for public artifacts (certs, CSR) to avoid Slack/email attachments. Do not upload private keys. For network peering, send netops contact to maya.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2391 for private-poc-key-provisioning and assigned to Maya_Onboard, Art_Infra.
kitecorp_ops: We'll generate the CSR and send the CSR PEM + KMS ARN by EOD. Also will create an IAM role trust policy for Redwood to assume for KMS access — need example policy.
Maya_Onboard: Policy snippet (example) — replace ACCOUNT_ID and KEY_ARN accordingly:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-ijkl"
    }
  ]
}
```
We'll provide the exact principal once infra is ready.
Leo_Sec: :thumbsup: also confirm retention/rotation windows and ensure key policies restrict Decrypt to the Redwood service principal only (for POC timeframe).
Sam_AE: Thanks — Maya, can you send the checklists + presigned URL + pricing note to KiteCorp and cc legal for a DPA addendum? I'll update deal in Salesforce.
Maya_Onboard: On it — I'll post the handoff doc + links in this thread when ready. ETA 2h.
kitecorp_ops: Great, thanks team. We'll push CSR + KMS details later today.
Sam_AE: Perfect. Closing loop here once artifacts received.
